headline: Transformation-led growth and premiumisation drive market share gains

highlights: We note: (1) Domestic growth remained robust, with the company continuing to outperform the industry and gain market share across key segments.

Management's continued focus on brand investments, innovation and go-to- market capabilities is likely to strengthen its competitive positioning, while operating efficiencies are beginning to deliver benefits.
PAT grew by 21.0%/72.1%/76.1% YoY, driven by strong demand across categories and channels.
However, exports revenue declined 30.5% YoY due to global disruptions.
valuation: Upgrade to BUY (from Hold) with a DCF-based revised TP of INR 725 (earlier INR 700; implied target P/E at 37x FY28E EPS).

Strategic expenditure during H1FY27 stood at INR 300mn. • The company continues to target steady-state EBITDA margins of ~13-14%, • Inventory has increased in value, primarily due to anticipated demand and preparations to support business growth.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
